summary_en: Vega Corporation authorized acquisition of up to 100,000 shares (0.94% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥150 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 2 to December 18, 2026, to support flexible capital management.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Vega Corporation announced on October 30, 2026 that its board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury shares pursuant to the Companies Act Article 459(1) and the company's Articles of Incorporation Article 41. The company will acquire up to 100,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 0.94% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury shares) as of the authorization date, for a maximum aggregate amount of ¥150 million. Purchases will be made through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 2 to December 18, 2026. The purpose of the acquisition is to implement flexible capital policies. As of the authorization date, the company held 100,427 treasury shares, including 80,150 shares held by Japan Custody Bank (as trustee for the J-ESOP program) and 10,649,173 shares outstanding excluding treasury shares.
